module.name: Wake Up Calls
module.description: FreePBX module for generating reminder and wakeup calls
module.changelog: *17.0.1.8* Added repeat wakeup call option in the Add/Edit Wakeup Call modal: consecutive days, specific weekdays, or until a given date (ported from the 16.0 branch). The Time field in the Add/Edit Wakeup Call modal now always displays/accepts 24h format (e.g. "14:30") instead of the jquery.timepicker plugin's default 12h "2:30 pm". Added a "Wakeup Time Step" setting (5/10/15/30 minutes, default 15) on ?display=hotelwakeup_settings controlling the granularity of the times offered in the Time dropdown -- typing an exact time still always works regardless of this setting. Fixed the repeat/weekday checkboxes and the selected Language dropdown item rendering with the browser's default blue instead of the FreePBX theme color in the Add/Edit Wakeup Call modal. Added cache-busting (filemtime-based version query string) to the wakeup.js/settings.js/global.js/messages.js includes: without it, a browser tab left open across a module update kept running the previous JS, which on the Settings page silently dropped any field the stale script didn't know to send and surfaced as a "missing parameters" save error. *17.0.1.7* #issue-991 wakeup call audio instruction issue fix *17.0.1.6* bump *17.0.1* 17.0
